reviewText: Finally a puzzle game that doesn't heat up my phone! Super smooth 60fps experience.
Loving the map progression system. Har stage ka challenge alag hai, bilkul bored nahi hote. Best timepass game for my commute.
Solid puzzle mechanics and the boosters are actually useful for the tougher stages. Graphics are clean and crisp.
Game toh achha hai, but kuch higher levels thode zyada challenging hain. Still, satisfying to clear them after a few tries.
Great lightweight app. Runs perfectly on my older device without any lag or crashes.
